bugLogs.title: Insufficient Color Contrast
affected_users: older users with declining contrast sensitivity
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the text color of the product prices
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The visual presentation of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The product price text has a contrast ratio of 2.32, which is below the minimum required ratio of 4.5:1
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Increase the darkness of the text color or lighten the background color to achieve a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

bugLogs.title: Missing Image Alt Text
bugLogs.expected_behavior: All non-text content has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Images are missing alt attributes, aria-label, or other text alternatives.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to all informative images, or use alt="" for decorative images.
